body: Moon Plains - situated in Nuwara Eliya, Sri Lanka. Among the jagged peaks of the Central Highlands of Sri Lanka; are the surprisingly beautiful and vast slopes of the Moon Plains. Located just off the Nuwara Eliya city; this most recently opened attraction, was once the dump site of the tons of garbage used by the dwellers of the nearby city. The main point of interest is the viewpoint of the ‘Mini World’s End’. A location on the apex of a sharply dropping cliff, that gives a 360º view of the surrounding landscape. As such, the Moon Plains prove to be an ideal place for a hike or a cycling tour, with beautiful landscapes galore. The view from the Mini World’s Peak at sunrise is especially spectacular; with the golden glow of the sun, mixing with the mist that wreaths the peaks and valleys surrounding the area. This location is not to missed during a visit. Very interesting place in Nuwara Eliya.
title: 360º view of Sri Lanka

body: We visited Moon Plains on 1 May and fortunately the weather improved as we are nearing the viewing point. Entrance fee is 400 rupees each for foreigners and 50 for locals. After paying the entrance fee, you need to hire a Jeep for 2,000 rupees to get to the viewpoint (driving through the vegetables farm). You can see the surrounding mountains and Nuwara Eliya city from here. It was very windy when we arrived at around 9am+ and cold. So come with some warm clothing.

body: Moon plain is a recently discovered area in Nuwara Eliya. It is situated in a farming area belong to agriculture department (according to our safari jeep guide). To visit this place first you have to go to farm office where you have to buy tickets. From the same point safari jeeps available for you to take. I can summarize costs as follows (as of April 2019)- Cost per person - Rs 50/- (This is to be paid to farm office and they don't charge for kids)- Cost for the safari jeep - Rs 2000/-One jeep has a capacity of about 6 and if you are with a small group you can join up with another group or family and share the cost as we did. Ride to the plain is about 20 mins and it is a jumpy ride. We have to go through many potato fields. Once you go to the plain you will be astonished by the view as it is totally detached from the urban area. From here you can have a 360 degree view hence you can see almost all the mountain ranges from here. Knuckles range in Badulla district to Piduruthalagala range. Sri Pada range was covered because of another mountain range and mist.We can stay about 30 mins on the plain to enjoy the view. We went in a morning and it wasn't misty too much. I think evening times can be more misty.
title: Nice view of mountain ranges

body: This is one of the nice place in Nuwaraeliya. Not so far from Nuwaraeliya town. There are cabs in this place. You cant get your own vehicle until observation place. Cab price is 2000 rupee. 9 people can travel together in one cab.Entrance fee for adult Sri Lankan is 50 rupee. Only if you are nature lover visit this place. If not this will be very boring place to you. Before this place was agricultural land. Sometimes you can see animal species which are specific to Sri Lanka. There is an observation place in moon plains. You can see mountain range in 360°view. And there is a border of central province of Sri Lanka and Uva province. You can capture group photos here with 360 ° view. It is very awesome. Roming apart from the main road is prohibited.Entering into the cultivation without permission is prohibited.Harming plants and animals and collecting sample is prohibited.Throwing polythene and garbage randomly is prohibited.Carrying alcohol and drugs into the tourist zone is strictly prohibited.Staying after 6.00 p.m within the zone is prohibited.Maximum one hour can spent at the observation place.
title: "The environmental and Agricultural tourism zone "

body: This is located very close to the city of Nuwaraeliya. Once you get to the entrance, you will have to take a safari jeep to get to the top of the plain. The specialty here is you have an obscured 360-degree view of 07 of Sri Lanka's main mountains. Definitely worth a visit.
title: SUPERB!

body: Travelling in jeep was nice. Wide open area with the chances of seeing wild boar, cows, buffaloes, deer. At the viewpoint, you will be able to see the peak point of 9 mountains in Sri Lanka on a clear day.
title: Good view at the viewpoint

body: One of the best place to have a panoramic view of mountains in Sri Lanka. Recently added attraction in Nuwaraeliya with different kind of experience to the travelers. Ideal for a family visit. Early Morning and evening would be the best timings. Good alternative to the travelers especially with kids and elders who hesitate to visit Horton planes due to the distance to walk. Just 3km away from the town so easily reach and you can hire 4WD truck for 2000 LKR for 5-6 Pax. you can park your vehicle safely near the starting place and round trip would take nearly 1 hour.
title: Must Visit place in Nuwaraeliya

body: This is a wonderful place but if you need a unforgettable experience visit the place around 7am.The chargers for a Jeep from locals is around LKR 2000/ and 6 people can travel.All drivers are well informed about the geographical details , if your getting some telescopic photoes please get the location details ftom the driver as the area is 360°view you will see many town surrounding this are. Which i missed to do.
title: Amazing place

body: Since an animal safari at Minneriya National Park wasn't possible, I chose to explore the safari (non animal safari) at Moon Plains, Nuwara Eliya. This wasn't anywhere close to what it would have been at Minneriya, but the experience was bliss!Entry fee: LKR 400 per pax (tourists) ; LKR 50 (locals) ; LKR 2K (total cost of one jeep: 5-7 pax)Duration: 45 mins - 1 hour I visited Moon Plains in the Month of March, at around 3:00 pm. Mornings are the ideal time to visit. But I was definitely fortunate, to get a great view in the afternoon! Once there, you cannot use your own vehicle to drive up. There are designated jeep drivers, to drive you around. Along the way, pretty plains/hills and wild buffaloes can be observed. Having lived in the city for years, this was my chance to experience a jeep drive. So the bumpy drive, was definitely not a bother! Once you reach the farthest place, the tour guide takes you to the top most view point (there will be a little trek). From here one can get a magnificent view, of Lanka's 9 mountains. - Advance booking isn't mandatory. - Women shouldn't go here alone. - Clothing that are suited for trekking are ideal. It is advisable to carry a jacket, as it can get cold. - Do not forget to carry a bottle of water. - P. S. Moon Plains is located in a secluded place & there are no eateries around. - P. S. Washrooms aren't clean
title: The Unknown Safari - Awesomeness!!

body: What a place on earth, this is a man made plains, but the breathtaking views around this place makes it a must visit place in Sri Lanka. Little known to people, so less crowded.
title: Your trip to Sri Lanka is incomplete without visiting this place

body: We been to this place very randomly, it wasnt planned and not even heard about before. while we are planning for horton plains our tour guide suggested this place due to lack of time in our scheduled itinerary. We were amazed with the atosphere on top of the place with adventures bumy jeep ride and rain showers. PS. they provides umbrella too. as weather is really uncertain in nuwara eliya.If you are in the city and have enough time, dont waste it and must go to this place.
title: Must Go Place

body: The place is off Nuwaraeliya town, need to take an exit after the Gregory Lake. Drive takes around 15 mins to reach following the sign boards, you will reach a farm where there is a small office that will charge you 2600 LKR for a safari jeep to take you to the actual plains.The open safari jeep will take you through the winding roads while you will be able to take pictures, the driver will stop if you ask him to. As for the wildlife, the whole area is cordoned off by the use of electric fences, this is to protect the crops from hogs. The plain is used for potato farming. If you are lucky you will see some of the wildlife, we were lucky to see a moose running off to the forest through a broken part of the fence and that was it apart from the variety of birds.Once you reach the main view point, you will have a 360 degree view of the mountain range, fantastic view. The guide/driver will be able to tell you which mountain is which.Ensure you reach here early...at least by 7am so that you the mist will not hinder the view.
title: Amazing place

body: Good attraction not too far from the Nuwara Eliya city center. Can get there within 5 mins and the Safari to the view point takes about another 15 mins. If you do not have time to go to Horton Plains, this is a great way of site seeing.
title: Nice views, not too far from the city center

body: When we travelled to Nuwara Eliya, our driver told us about Moon Plains, but could not confirm if it is a worth visit as he had never visited this place. We went there after lunch and were told that the place was closed. So we thought of giving it a try in the morning again, before we go back to Colombo. We went there right after breakfast and found a lot of people waiting for the experience. We decided to wait for an hour max as we had to go back to Colombo. The place was not well organized, ticket counter was crowded and the lady in the counter cannot converse well in English. It is important that staff at any international tourist destination converse in English so that it is easy for the tourists. The place is also not well organized and people keep rushing to board the safari vehicle the moment they see one coming. After waiting for almost an hour and following up with the staff several times, our chance for getting on to the safari truck came. It was a bumpy ride initially, but was totally worth it. The views are amazing. And once you get to the final destination, it is splendid. We were glad we stayed back to visit the Moon Plains.Not to forget, like many other attractions in Srilanka, the discounted pricing for Srilankans is available even here. I would certainly recommend all tourists visiting Nuwara Eliya to visit the Moon Plans.
title: Definitely worth visiting

body: The views from the top are amazing, however the entry fee is too steep. The same views can be seen from places that can be accessed for free. The staff were nice and the drive through the farm interesting. Make sure if you take a tuk tuk there they know where they are going, there is a few places called moon plains in the area.
title: Great views. Big price

body: We visited Moon Plains on 01st of February 2018. One of the best times to visit the plains was early morning so we arrived at 8am. The authorized jeep ride was about 20 minutes long and we spotted a Sambar and some endemic Sri Lankan birds on the way. The distance of the ride was about 3km one way. There is a well built view point to experience the 360 degree view of 10 famous mountain ranges in Sri Lanka(Piduruthalagala, Hakgala, Kirigalpoththa,..etc)Moon Plains is also famous as the home to the "Mini Worlds End".
title: Once in a lifetime experience

body: This is an excellent view point in Nuwara Eliya which you could easily reached with a vehicle. You can't access there by your own vehicle instead have to hire a safari jeep from there and it will take you to the moon plains passing beautiful landscapes.The climate change with in minute in this place as when we reach there we couldn't see anything because of the mist and with in two minutes it was sunny and had a great view of mountains.For old visitors it is hard to visit places like Horton plains and so for such travellers Moon Plains is the best option which give you a same kind of feeling just as in Horton Plains.This place is new bee and not older than 3 years so in your next visit to Nuwara Eliya make sure you go and explore this beautiful land side.
title: Amazing view port with out tired of walking

body: Location is about 4Km away from the center of the city. You can drive up to the gate.Then you have to user the jeeps provided by the park to go up to the observation deck.On your way you can see the beautiful landscaping of the nature.
title: Nice and cool place for site seeing

body: We went on moon plains safari on our day 2 of the 3 days we stayed in Nuwara Eliya. We would recomment to anyone to visit here for scenary.
title: Nice attraction

body: Very beautiful views from the top of the mountain. Much more convenient that all other places which are far, uncomfortable or more expensive. Just a few kilometers from town you arrive at this place (managed by an Agricultural Center) where you can take a jeep with driver (not expensive), which go up to the hill where you can have a beautiful view of all the surroundings.
title: Nice views, very convenient to go

body: You will be charged at the entrance and except that you have to rent out a jeep for 2000Rs . When it come to view ,thats amazing one of the must visit place.
title: Lovely place

body: While not in the same scale as Horton Plains, the mini worlds end at Moonplains does offer a great and unique 360 degree view of the surrounding mountain ranges around Nuwara Eliya. The entrance is very close to Nuwara Eliya town, and from the entrance you have to take a safari jeep to the viewing platform. You can't hike on it. It's about 15 to 20 minute drive over hard terrain. If you a travelling alone, the jeeps are a bit expensive, but the jeep can accommodate 7, so if you can get a group, you can share the cost. If its crowded, then you might have to wait a while to get a jeep, since there are a limited number available. If you a travelling with small children, Moonplains is a great alternative to Horton Plains. It's plus points are:- its closer to town- you don't have to hike all the way- doesn't take a long time- offers a unique view
title: A great view

body: We were freezing all the way in an open jeep, sitting on wet seats, to find out there is absulotely nothing in this place.
title: Waste of time and money

body: It was just okay, the view was wonderful from the top of the lookout point but nothing compared to Horton Plains. The jeep took about 15mins on a bumpy ride to the lookout. The whole visit is limited to two hous at most. Its no value to pay the jeep hire (Rs5000)and entrance fee (Rs400) for such view. You get much more magnificent view for free Mini Adam's Peak of Ella.
title: Just Ok

body: It was lovely to see in srilanka we have a such beautiful place..the journey in the Jeep was really excited and my kids enjoyed a lot..the drive who took us was very kind and informative.. overall it was a great experience..
title: Great place

body: We paid rs400 each for the entrance fee and rs5000 to rent a jeep. The jeep took us on a 15 minute ride to the view point which had a viewing deck. It is a must visit you have extra budget as the view was stunning. It has a similar view as world's end according to our guide but without the hike. It wasn't crowded at all so it was very enjoyable.
title: Stunning view

body: We stumbled over Moonplains by accident and decided to explore it. You have to go from the potato farm on special jeeps (its a mud track and cars cant go up) which charge SL 2,000 per trip. It takes around 20 mins to get to the top and you can stay there for an hour. There is a viewing platform which lets you have an incredibale view of the surrounding mountains and vallyes. At times it is misty but the weather in NE is such that the clouds/mist shifts quickly giving you a glimpse of the faraway mountains. For us the view and magic of the place was worth the cost.
title: Breathtaking View

body: This is situated about 1 km from the main road at the edge of George Lake on the way to Sita Eliya. Ashok is a very good host. The place is located in a calm place. This is only for those who want to stay away from the buzz. If you take a tuk tuk from bus stand you will have to pay 300 LKR. You will not get dinner here. If you inform in advance Ashok will prepare something for you. Not a high flying place. Needs to have more contact with tuk tuk drivers for him to serve his guests. Needs to serve food at night since it is away from town.I
title: For those who want to stay away from town

body: Offering you a similar view to famous Horton Plains, Moons plain is another beautiful attraction in Sri Lanka kept secret. Located in Nuwara Eliya, the main attraction of the place is ‘the drop’ which known as the ‘second world’s end’. Misty plains of green grass saturated with a diversity of flora and fauna is an ideal place for anyone who is looking for some pristine nature.
title: Moon Plains

body: We only got to know about this after arriving in Nuwara Eliya. Sadly we could not visit Horton plains with the small kids and moonplains turned out to be the perfect replacement. Kids enjoyed the jeep ride a lot and at the very end there is an observation desk that you can see 8 out of 9 highest points in Sri Lanka. Must visit for anyone.
title: Newest attraction in Nuwara Eliya

body: This is close by to Nuwaraeliya town. Once you arrive you might think that this could not be the Moon Plains. There is a potato farm belongs to Ministry of agriculture and through this farm only you have to go to Moon Plains. This farm produce the seeds n plants for potato farmers across sri Lanka therefore its a protected area. you need to buy the ticket (entrance ticket) at the counter and pay separately for the jeeps. they wont allow private vehicles to enter to the Moon plains as it goes through the farm. The jeeps are 2000 rupees and minimum 7 to 8 people can travel in it. you can share the jeep as well. these vehicles are not allowed to go out of the farm as well.Simply they do not want any substances which can harm the potato plants to bring in side. leave all your belongings in your vehicle and dont take anything so there is tendency to litter the moon plains.you will travel through the bumpy roads to reach the point and there is viewing deck as well. on your way you can see deers (actually the bigger version ) and mountains. its the view which is breathtaking so no activity or anything else to see or do. vehicle will stay for 20 - 30 minutes and take you back to the farm. you have to pay the amount to the driver once you finish the journey.
title: Breathtaking view

body: We visited Moons Plains during our visit to Nuwara Eliya. It's about half an hour drive from Nuwara Eliya city. You have to drop your car at the entry ticket office and book a Jeep as it is a off road drive further. For SAARC adult they charge LKR 400 per head and another LKR 2000 for a private Jeep. One Jeep can accommodate up to 6 people. It's a bumpy ride to the plains so please do take care of kids while in the Jeep. The driver also act as a guide so a small tip at the end of the trip would be good. You can spend almost 30-45 minutes at the main spot. Amazing place to visit for all age groups. Beautiful scenery, dense forest, mountains, cliffs and can spot few animals if you are lucky enough. It's a must visit site if in Nuwara Eliya. Take as many pictures, I am sure you will find one of the best wallpaper pic at this spot.
title: Nature lovers paradise

body: Moon Plains is a good experience in Nuwara Eliya since there is not many activities that you could do there so it was exciting for us to go on a safari on,the mountains. We reached there in the morning around 10 am but couldn't see any deer or rabbits since they go into hiding for the noise that the safari jeeps make. Yet, there were wild buffaloes. We also saw acres of potato plantation. The guide who drove the Jeep was very friendly and showed us the different cities that can be seen from up above. Within 20 minutes we were driven down again. It costs lkr 2000 to rent the Jeep and lkr 50 per person.
title: Top of Nuwara eliya

body: Its a safari jeep trip to the moon planes. Its the only place which can see the entire mountain range in one place. some times you can see some animals some times you may not. but its nice great place to visit. you can see the potato seed farms on your way and a cool climate at the edge.
title: Tript to The edge

body: If you want to feel shocked and awed at the same time,this should be the perfect place for that. The only place with a 360 degree view of 9 mountains and rightfully deserves its name, 'Mini World's End". A safari jeep needs to be hired at the entrance to take the 2 hour long journey. Slightly expensive for Rs.2000, but the guides were quite competent and friendly.Make it a must on the agenda on your next visit to Nuwara Eliya. If you are lucky enough you can also see several wild animals as well. Recommended to travel early in the morning.Really wish to see how the view would look like on a full moon's night!!
title: Breathtaking View!!

body: The jeep safari was fun, the great scenery, the fresh air, my only disapointment was the heavy fog on the top of the plains ...we couldn't take photos nor see the surrondings...
title: Nice view from top...

body: This is a beautiful location and worth visiting. They charge and entrance fee and then they charge you separately for the safari jeep. The price printed on the board was 2000 srilankan. But the driver insisted we pay 4000 srilankan which was double the listed price. We paid because we had come up all the distance. Left a bad feeling of being taken for a ride.
title: Top of the world

body: Moon plains is situated About 3 kms from Nuwara Eliya.. you have to hire a safari jeep to get you to the plains .. we drove through potato fields ... a bumpy ride but the kids Enjoyed the experience .. entrance was rs 50/- .. breath taking view from the top .. It's a 360 degree view of 9 mountains on a clear day .. it's always better to get there early before the mist rolls in .. well worth a trip if you are holidaying in nuwara eliya..
title: What a view .. Moon Plains

body: Very attractive place to visit. We must used to jeep service provided by the farm and need to pay the jeep+tickets.Jeep can accommodate 6 peoples. All travel time is around 2-3 hours. Morning visit are recommended.
title: Heart touching view

body: Anyone can go, good stoning views. Beautiful picture, good place for a snack as well as group photos. Pleasant climate while sunny. However jeep drivers needs better understanding of tourism, ei, the do not find interesting places although go up to the mountain as there would be any possible target.
title: Nice place to explore, try to use different type of equippment

body: The tour takes around 2 hours and if its a clear sunny day the view from the top is fantastic. Still you cannot compare with Horton Plains which is far better in respect of view and horticulture you get there. You cannot go in your own vehicles but have to hire a jeep from the office below.
title: Tour of Moon Plains

body: The 360 view of the Central Province and the Uva Province you find from the top of the moon plains at the view point is just breathtaking. Seven mountains inluding the three tallest mountains can be seen from Moon Plains. If you visit there in the morning, probably you might see some wild animals. Even though it is the afternoon, two or three wild animals will surely be caught to your sight! :) Once you reach the Moon Plains office, you are supposed to reserve a safari jeep to ascend moon plains.. No wonder this is called a min worlds' end! :)
title: Amazing Scenary!

body: A breath taking view. Just a few minutes away from NuwaraEliya town. It is not possible to imagine that there is such a place in NuwaraEliya.Very nice place....
title: Heaven Meets Earth

body: Location is close to city. Lovely scenery which was 360 went you reach the top it becomes cold and windy. You have to stop your vehicle there ans take their safari jeeps. There were vegetable cultivation to seen at first when moving further wild animals were to been seen when we were traveling. At times mist was covering up.
title: Stunning view

body: It's a rough jeep ride through the park so be prepared to be jolted. Up hill trek to the viewing point so be prepared for walking on uneven road. But the views are stunning so worth a visit
title: Amazing Scenery

body: The mini safari and view point is best location to have scenic view of all mountains and peaks.The signage to place is not clear and we have to ask many people for directions.
title: An excellent place to see all major mountains and peaks .

body: Moonplain is a windy summit that will blow your mind. You can see nice spectacular view of large number of mountains from one place. Please make sure that you tie your belonging as wind can be so powerful at some times.
title: Windy Summit

body: This is must see place in Nuwara Eliya. Last time (November 2015)we went in a morning and couldn't see anything due to thick mist. This time we drive straight to Moon Plains and got in to a jeep in the noon. View from this place is amazing. You can see 8 mountain ranges (Piduruthalagala, Namunukula, Hakgala, Thotupola, Kirigalpoththa, great western, single tree and kikiliyamanna) in your 360 degree view.What i heard from the Jeep driver is that morning is the best time to go to this place as you may see wild animals also. But I recommend noon as less chances of mist that can hide your view totally.
title: Second visit on a perfect day

body: Moon Plains is a new attraction in Nuwara Eliya managed by by a govt. department. The ride in the jeep passing the seed potato farm is rather bumpy in a jeep, but an interesting experience over rough terrain. Once you reach the viewpoint, you get a beautiful 360 degree view of the surrounding peaks and towns. It is like a mini World's End but the view is wider if the weather is good. The plains is said to be home to elk, wild buffaloes, deer and a variety of birds, but we saw only jungle fowls and wild buffaloes in the distance. It can be very windy on top.One problem is that this is not a guided tour, and everything is left to private jeep drivers. The lack of toilet facilities at either end is a problem. The Dept. of Agriculture should be more receptive to needs of tourists, both local and foreign (who are charged much more). A good brochure explaining the attraction and safety concerns should be provided.
title: Scenic ride and great views

body: Beautiful sceneries. But the ride upto the viewing point is so bumpy, elderly people or those with back pains would find it difficult.Rs.2000 for the safari jeep. Driver did not explain anything about the surrounding.Very close to Nuwara eliya Gregory lake.Sign Boards are put up.
title: closeby and newer attraction

body: Small drive off Nuwara Eliya, the entrance is situated in Badulla road closer to Gregory lake. Guiding boards are placed, so it is not hard to find the way.Situated inside the Potate farm, tourists will have to buy a ticket of Rs. 50 (for locals) per head and Rs. 2000 (for locals) for the jeep. They do not allow any other vehicles than those jeeps. Better to avoid doing so, since the road condition is really bad. Considering the travel time and the distance personally feels Rs. 2000 is too much. It is a great panoramic view one can get when reached to the place. Observation deck is also there. Refer my photos for the view
title: Must sea in Nuwara Eliya

body: This is not a safari. It is a drive up a hill on a track through farm land to a viewing platform. Yes good view but can see this in other places for free; here it will set you back 5000 rupee for the jeep plus entry 400 rupee per person.
title: Waste of Time

body: Located 30 min drive away from the city of nuwaraeliya this place is a easy accessible even for a elderly person. Actually this land is own by Sri Lankan government and used to produce potato seeds. You can easily drive your own car to the farm and from there you have take the safari jeeps. After driving across the farm with beautiful mesmerizing views you can reach the view point. Take your wind angles and perfect for time lapse videos. They open at 7 a.m. Go early as possible you'll be lucky.
title: Only for landscape lovers

body: Moons plains is most suitable and outstanding environmental view in Nuwara eliya. It's not far away from the city. In hear we can see 7 highest mountain in Sri Lanka and this is the only one place can see like this. And also can see 360• view from hear different districts and many cities in Sri Lanka.
title: Moons plains

body: Location is not so far from the city. 4km drive by a safari jeep from the ticket counter to destination. the view will disappear suddenly by mist.
title: lucky tourists will see a grate view

body: Went with Family... Foggy in the evenings... you can see five provinces in Sri Lanka.... View should be fantastic when no mist. Haven't seen any animals. Kids enjoyed the Jeep rids
title: Beatutiful place

body: latest attraction open to public in Nuwara Eliya, place for agricuntural and environmental tourism.New attarction. Very good place
title: Latest attraction

body: It is very close to the nuwara eliya city center. You have to buy tickets in there for persons and for a jeep too. It will take 2000 for a jeep. Try to go there in the morning. Because in the evening it is very misty. Hard to see the breathtaking views. There's a viewing point in the end of the road. Go there definitely. You can see a wide area from there.
title: A must go place

body: This is an dial place to visit in Nuwara Eliya Sri Lanka. More panoramic than Horton Plains. Very windy and natural grass land (plain) with surrounding mountains.
title: The Best Panoramic view of Mountains of Sri Lanka

body: This is very few milometers away from Nuwara Eliya town.This place is owing by the ministry of agriculture and this is the only potato seed farm in sri lanka which contribute 60% of the seed requirement in Sri Lanka.You can reach to the entrance by your own vehicle and from there you need to buy a jeep to reach to moonplains. Non of the other vehicles are permitted to enter in to the farm due to germ protection rules. You need to buy tickets to enter in to the moon plains and also you need to buy hire a vehicle from them. Those are safari type covered jeeps and you may buy a one which suits to the capacity.If you visit on the rainy season make sure to check the covers before you leave, because you may get wet if not. There can be heavy rains and heavy winds time to time and its better you may prepare to cover and secure your mobile phones and cameras when needed.Also please be careful when you are climbing the staircase of the small building over there if there is heavy wind. Actually this is a wonderful experience and the surrounding is very calm and beautiful.I went twice there.One in April and another tour in August.April there was a clear background and August there was heavy rains.But i might say its good to experience both situations. We have enjoyed a lot.
title: Wonderful Moonplains

body: The only bad experience in our entire SL visit. If the organisation managing this ever reads this review they will understand my displeasure and the rest who have been writing. Money mentioned on the price list for jeep ride is multiplied 3times and expected by foreign tourists to pay. Disobedience to visitors on the face. Very Bad experience. Not sure how they work?
title: Don't even try

body: Moon plains is relatively newer attraction in the very close proximity to the city center. This pinnacle point includes a viewing deck which gives you an uninterrupted view for many famous mountain ranges in Sri Lanka. Mist plays a major contributor to your clear view. I visited twice to this place around noon where the sky was very clear and the was magnificent. The route to the viewing deck is inside a potato research and a farm and it takes approximately 20 minutes to reach the destination from the ticketing point. The ticketing staff are not helpful as they only consider on getting money and trying to quickly book us on a jeep but rather never gives much information of what in store for us. Jeep drivers attitudes too depending. On my first visit the driver was kind to stop in between the way and explain each and every attraction as we pass by. But this time our driver quickly took us to the point but never offer to explain the attractions. Sadly there was no leaflets at the ticket counter for reference. It seems like this ticketing for foreigners are quit exorbitant, for locals it was quite cheap. But I too agree with comments on unreasonably overpriced and at the same time less value for money for foreigners.
title: Single view point for many mountain ranges

body: We visited the entrance to the moon plains which is actually a large potato farm. The foreign ticket price was 400 rupi pp and 5000 rupi for a jeep tour of 5 km. Price was non negotionable cause they had other jobs to do. Since it was very cloudy and very expensive, we decided not to go.Looks amuturistic, organised by some farmers who want to take their share of the tourists.
title: Moon plains

body: We all went to moon plains on September 2 . when we got there and was climbing the stairs one of our friend fainted . Then we took him to the jeep and told them to go to hospital but they said they can't go beyond the moon plain gate! then we had to search for a three wheel and it took us about 5 mins and our friend passed away on the way to the hospital because of heart failure.... The place is good to see but the staff is not good enough!
title: "Staffs Not Helpful"

body: we went to the ticket office and and they were very rude to us and they were laughing to us, like we were idiots, the jeep price they have advertise was Rs 2000 and they ask us to pay Rs 5000. I think this place is corrupted cheaters and we gave up the moon plains and went to Hortan Plains
title: worst place ever in sri lanka

body: This is one of the not so common attraction in Nuwara-eliya and we thought to try it during our short stay in Nuwara-eliya. This is best to start early in the morning and the we were there by 7.30 am to take the first tours before the crowd building up to avoid waiting. We hired a safari vehicle which can accommodate up to 7 people. The driver took us far in to the plains and we realise that wind and cold weather started to building up as we drive further. The end point of the safari if very windy place with a spectacular view so you can spent sometime enjoying the view and wind.
title: The ultimate wind you can get..

body: Moon plains is beautiful and can be visited as a substitute to "World's end which takes longer time" if only you can avoid the ticketing staff and jeep drivers which is practically impossible. They will charge you more if you are a foreigner and if you point out the unfair pricing they will argue, scream and disrespect you. While the entry fee was clearly mentioned separately for foreigners (which we had no problem paying), they demanded extra for jeep (which wasn't mentioned anywhere). They refused to take us unless we paid more and even threatened us that we were in Sri lanka ( Don't know what they were implying) when we demanded an explanation for charging us more. Also, there were no restrooms for ladies and god knows how we managed 4 hours without it. No wildlife around and bumply road up the hill.The country is beautiful but we wouldn't want to go back due to the these unpleasent encounters.
title: Amazing place but rude ticketing staff and jeep drivers

body: it is said that it is somewhat like horton plain. but when my driver came along with us he said horton plain is quite interesting. Since this is new site. Govt needs to invest lot of money and develop it. infrastructure is less.
title: not much developed

body: Just a great trip, cost 7000lkr for a family of four for the jeep safari.Long bumpy ride across the "plains" was absolutely amazing with the clouds passing by and the cold winds, at the top 9 different famous peaks of Sri Lanka were visible. There isn't any fixed price, bargain as much as you can. Go on a clear rain free day as the view wasn't complete with the rain clouds. The guide was a nice guy and explained many things on the way.
title: Wow, breathtaking view!

body: This site was not included in our plan but our tour operator recommended it, because it is not far from Nuwara Eliya and it was really worth, despite it costed almost 50 dollars per 2 person. To reach the tot spot, the jeep drove us through the government potato seed farm, it is very beautiful way, where we had a long stop (upon our request) because up there, built on high terrace and you can watch the surroundings which consist of green meadows and 8-9 high mountains.In one word- amazing.
title: safari trip

body: this is one safari that can be avoided. overpriced at SKR 5000 for 2, the open jeep drives up the mountain to an unremarkable viewing tower. The drive is through potato farms and the bumpy road is about the only exciting part of the journey. there are abso no animals to be seen, just miles of human encroachment on forest land through farming. The only redeeming factor was the sight of the majestic mountains from the view point and the complex cacaphony of jungle sounds that were audible in that area. I am thankful for getting to the edge of the jungle at least.
title: disappointing!

body: This should be the first plan when someone traveling in nuwaraeliya. You can see main mountains in Sri Lanka in a clear day. Make sure to visit at 7am and get a safari jeeps. I heard they have 14 jeeps in their pool. You an see 360' view in summit and there is a mini worlds end.
title: New attraction in nuwaraeliya

body: We decided to visit Moon Plains after reading a review in a Sri Lankan Sunday supplement about this new attraction and it suited us as we have a 4 year old and it's very close to Nuwara Eliya. From the article, we expected a natural wilderness, wildlife, including many bird species and culminating in a wonderful viewpoint. Well, a natural wilderness, this certainly ain't. The drive to the view point is through 3km of potato seed fields, farmed in an intensely chemical way, so much so that the stench from the pesticides they were spraying was often overwhelming. This intense farming runs right the way up to the view point, a little viewing tower on top of a small hill. The view from the viewpoint is absolutely outstanding however. I counted 8 layers of hills and mountains through the morning mists. Probably the best view I've seen in Sri Lanka but they need to find a much more attractive way of getting you to it
title: Potato viewpoint!

body: Fantastic views of the sri lankan mountains. Rented a jeep for 8000 plus tickets for 1000. Worth every penny
title: Great place!

body: Opens at Sri-lankan 6.30 am!! and you will be taken by jeep to the view point where there are quite stunning views across to Ella and back to Nuwara Eliya and Hakgalla. It is definitely worth getting up for a dawn trip. This is relatively unknown but it is a realistic alternative to Worlds End at Horton Plains and very similar. Thanks to our Driver Shammi who knew about this and arranged it.
title: Stunning 360 degree views

body: It takes just 10 mins drive from the Nuwara Eliya town...Once you reach the starting point you have to pay upfront for the jeep (2000 Rs per jeep which can easily transport 6 people) and a very nominal entry fee (atleast for locals) 50rs per adult and 25rs per child....a 20 min jeep ride through beautiful potatoes estates take you to the top of viewing area and the view is breathtaking....Definitely worth a visit
title: Serene...Calm...Beautiful

body: I have been to world's end two times and I just wanted to try the new concept of moon plains. It's totally different from world end and we can see much animals than world and and seven mountains of srilanka as well. It's good for save time and not to be tiered of walking to worlds end.
title: Really wonderful to visit

body: New Attraction. The main attraction is the view of several mountain peaks (on a clear day - we were very fortunate despite the weather forecast to have brilliant weather). And if you are early enough (6.30 a.m), you can catch sight of some animal life (Sambur, Peacocks,Kites..if the sound of the truck does not scare them away!). You have to take the available privately run safari truck a bit overpriced for a 45mn drive. Personal vehicles not allowed due to pollution - not sure how the diesel safari trucks qualify over a hybrid non pollutant SUV. But one of the few things to do in Nuwara Eliya.Only access to location by private vehicle.
title: Panaromic View

body: Moon plains is a newly established Mini World's end in Nuwaraeliya. It is situated at Potato seed farm-Seethaeliya. It is essentially need to have a private vehicle to reach there from Nuwaraeliya town as public transportation is not operated there.Though you go by your vehicle, to enter the Moon Plains you have to hire a safari jeep. It costs Rs 2000 for locals. After about 45 minutes travel you will reach the observation point. During the jeep transportation you are not allowed to get down.From this observation point you can view nine highest peaks of Sri Lanka except Adam's peak. But it happens in a clear day. In a misty day it is just a visit only.This is not an alternative for Hortain Plains.
title: Better visit in a clear day!

body: good place to visit but not much greenish view nothing to say i we colud see some animals deers more
title: good

body: This is the newest attraction in N'Eliya after Horton plains.Take the road near gregory lake & follow the sign boards.Some wild life is present (Sambar,Monkey,Eagles...).You can see 6 out of seven major mountains from the peak.A Must do!
title: Breathtaking Views

body: Great nature tour and nice view. Price was little high. They charged $25 per person. But we enjoyed lot on first day of the year.
title: Nature ride

body: Probably this is a newly setup attraction. This is actually a potato plantation. Now they have set up a sight seeing excavation as side business it seems. You drive up to their office, park your vehicle, pay for the Jeep. Jeeps are all new (indian jeeps). We had about 10 traveling in our Jeep and the cost was shockingly low (not sure if it is so for the tourists however we did not see any tourists). The jorney to the plains is about 6 kms... its a gravel road and there are a few patches where it is bit scary. Views are beautiful. Eventually you end up at a viewing point, where you can climb up and see entire sri lanka (just kidding).
title: A very Green Ride on a Bumpy Road

body: Moon Plains was suggested by our Travel Agent/ Driver and we really looked forward to visiting this place set in the beautiful Nuwara Eliya. The ticket cost is indicated as SLR 400 per head ( for Foreigners and Indians) which is way too high than the cost for locals which is SLR 50 per head. Apart from that, there was a Jeep Fee of SLR 2000 which was listed with no clarification or details. Not knowing the local language and lack of internet access can be a major problem as we got ripped off totally indicating that the jeep fee is SLR 2000 per head which is ridiculous. Unfortunately there was no body around to help and just because we traveled all the way there and wanted to see the place we ended up paying SLR 7200 for 3 people , where as it should have been only SLR 3200. And also we didnt get to see any animals apart from the occasional monkeys. Definitely good place but not worth it.
title: Good Place but not worth the Rip Off !

body: The tickets for admission was 400lkr then seeing we were not locals the jeep guy asked for 4200 lkr which was just quoted as they charge locals only 2000lkr finally we paid 2800lkr .we went at noon so did not see any animals according to the driver you see them post 4 pm
title: Moon plains

body: We were lucky the weather was sunny and clear. You could see the famous 7 mountains (don't remember the names:)). It is not very expensive. I wish there was a coffee place at the top to have a drink and enjoy the view
title: Amazing view and relaxing
Very good location
body: This is few miles away from Gregory lake. There will be a farm in the and you have to ask for a jeep ride, which cost around 3500 slr per 6 to 8 people. One you get in to the destination there is a view point, where you can observe whole Uva province in one go.

title: Fantastic View
body: Be there by 9AM before the clouds start rolling in. Place opens up at 7AM. Come there earlier and you will notice wild life.Superb 360 degree view. You are able to see the Highest Peak (Pidurutalagala), 2nd Highest peak (Kirigalpoththa), third highest peak (Thotupola Kanda), 6th Highest peak (Great Western Mountain), 7th highest peak (Hakgala).Need to park the vehicle at entrance and go in a safari jeep... can get quite cold during the ride and it can get windy at the look out point ( jeep ride for locals 2000/= for six persons)The look out point, indicates the directions at which the above mentioned mountains are visible

title: Bird eye View
body: The best time to travel is before 10.00 Am. We can reach entrance of Moon plains with our own vehicle or hired but no public transportation. Walking is prohibited through Moon plains except the given area. Private vehicles are not allowed to enter here and we need to take Safari jeep from the entrance(cost about 2000 LKR). If we reach to the peak in the morning (before the mist) we can see 360 view of surroundings.

title: An amazingly beautiful place not to be missed !!!
body: This place is just amazing with cold breeze and stunning views all around. If someone visit Nuwara Eliya, please do go see the beauty of this place. In my point of view, moon plains is better than horton plains. If you are lucky enough you will also see wild life there including leopards. But on the day of my visit, we couldn't see any. It was just amazing though. The driver who came with us was very friendly and he mentioned that the road is slippery if its raining but people even visit on rainy days. You also can experience a good off road tour ;) On the top most place it was so windy and freezing cold but we could see 360 view for sometime and suddenly it was vanished from the mist. Great experience!!!

title: New Attraction in Nuwara Eliya
body: This is said to be the highest elevation in Nuwara Eliya. This place has 360 degree view covering 6 mountain ranges of Sri Lanka.This place is accessed passing the the Government Potato seed Farm at Sita Eliya. This place is open for Public since early 2014. However when travel here you will see these mountain ranges or can experience thick mist. We experience latter (fortunately or unfortunately). To visit this place drive in to Government Potato seed Farm and at the car park take a vehicle (these vehicles are like what is available in many wildlife sanctuaries -rate is Rs. 2000 + entrance ticket fee ) and drive uphill on a bumpy road. This place open at 7:00 am but if you like to see scenic view better try to select clear time with no rain/mist. As what I heard from the driver / guide, February- April would be a better time.
